│          return importlib.import_module(&#x27;mobile_sam&#x27;)              │
│      except Exception:                                                       │
│          return None                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│  def parse_coords_from_string(s: str) -&gt; List[Tuple[int, int]]:           │
│      if s is None or str(s).strip() == &quot;&quot;:                         │
│          return []                                                           │
│      parts = [p.strip() for p in str(s).strip().split(&#x27;,&#x27;) if      │
│  p.strip() != &quot;&quot;]                                                  │
│      nums = [int(float(p)) for p in parts]                                   │
│      if len(nums) % 2 != 0:                                                  │
│          nums = nums[:-1]                                                    │
│      return [(nums[i], nums[i + 1]) for i in range(0, len(nums), 2)]         │
│                                                                              │
│  def coords_to_flat_list(coords: List[Tuple[int,int]]) -&gt;                 │
│  Tuple[List[int], List[int]]:                                                │
│      xs = [int(p[0]) for p in coords]                                        │
│      ys = [int(p[1]) for p in coords]                                        │
│      return xs, ys                                                           │
│                                                                              │
│  def polygon_to_mask(mask_shape: Tuple[int,int], poly:                       │
│  List[Tuple[int,int]]) -&gt; np.ndarray:                                     │
│      h, w = mask_shape                                                       │
│      m = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=np.uint8)                                    │
│      if len(poly) &gt;= 3:                                                   │
│          pts = np.array(poly, dtype=np.int32)                                │
│          cv2.fillPoly(m, [pts], color=255)                                   │
│      return m                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  def contour_of_mask(mask: np.ndarray) -&gt; List[Tuple[int,int]]:           │
│      contours, _ = cv2.findContours(mask, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL,                 │
│  cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)                                                    │
│      if not contours:                                                        │
│          return []                                                           │
│      c = max(contours, key=cv2.contourArea)                                  │
│      peri = cv2.arcLength(c, True)                                           │
│      approx = cv2.approxPolyDP(c, 0.01 * peri, True)                         │
│      return [(int(p[0][0]), int(p[0][1])) for p in approx]                   │
│                                                                              │
│  def contour_to_bbox(contour: List[Tuple[int,int]]) -&gt;                    │
│  Tuple[int,int,int,int]:                                                     │
│      if not contour:                                                         │
│          return 0,0,0,0                                                      │
│      pts = np.array(contour, dtype=np.int32)                                 │
│      x, y, w, h = cv2.boundingRect(pts)                                      │
│      return int(x), int(y), int(x+w-1), int(y+h-1)                           │
│                                                                              │
│  def refine_mask_with_mobile_sam(image: np.ndarray,                          │
│                                initial_geom: List[Tuple[int,int]],           │
│                                bbox: Tuple[int,int,int,int],                 │
│                                weights_path: str,                            │
│                                model: Optional[object] = None) -&gt;         │
│  Optional[np.ndarray]:                                                       │
│      &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                      │
│      Adaptive wrapper for MobileSAM-based refinement.                        │
│                                                                              │
│      Strategy:                                                               │
│      - If MobileSAM is available and API variants succeed, return the        │
│  refined mask.                                                               │
│      - Otherwise (or if API call fails), fall back to rasterizing the        │
│  provided polygon geometry.                                                  │
│      - Always returns a binary mask with the same height/width as the input  │
│  image (uint8 0/255), or None if still not derivable.                        │
│      &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                      │
│      h, w = image.shape[:2]                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│      # Fallback: rasterize the input geometry if enough points exist         │
│      if initial_geom and len(initial_geom) &gt;= 3:                          │
│          return polygon_to_mask((h, w), initial_geom)                        │
│                                                                              │
│      # If we reach here, we have insufficient geometry to rasterize; return  │
│  None (caller may skip)                                                      │
│      # Attempt MobileSAM if available                                        │
│      mobile = try_import_mobile_sam()                                        │
│      if mobile is None:                                                      │
│          return None                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          # Try common constructor patterns                                   │
│          model = None                                                        │
│          if hasattr(mobile, &#x27;MobileSAM&#x27;):                          │
│              try:                                                            │
│                  model = mobile.MobileSAM(weights_path,                      │
│  device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;)                                                     │
│              except Exception:                                               │
│                  model = None                                                │
│                                                                              │
│          if model is None and hasattr(mobile, &#x27;mobile_sam&#x27;):       │
│              try:                                                            │
│                  model = mobile.mobile_sam.MobileSAM(weights_path,           │
│  device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;)                                                     │
│              except Exception:                                               │
│                  model = None                                                │
│                                                                              │
│          if model is None:                                                   │
│              return None                                                     │
│                                                                              │
│          pts = np.array(initial_geom, dtype=np.int32)                        │
│                                                                              │
│          # Variant A: direct predict signature                               │
│          if hasattr(model, &#x27;predict&#x27;):                             │
│              try:                                                            │
│                  # Try a few plausible keyword variants                      │
│                  for kw in (&#x27;points&#x27;, &#x27;point_coords&#x27;,    │
│  &#x27;pts&#x27;, &#x27;points_coords&#x27;):                                │
│                      try:                                                    │
│                          out = model.predict(image, **{kw: pts})  # type:    │
│  ignore                                                                      │
│                          if isinstance(out, np.ndarray):                     │
│                              if out.dtype != np.uint8:                       │
│                                  out = out.astype(np.uint8)                  │
│                              if out.ndim == 3 and out.shape[2] == 3:         │
│                                  out = cv2.cvtColor(out,                     │
│  cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)                                                         │
│                              if out.shape[:2] != image.shape[:2]:            │
│                                  out = cv2.resize(out, (image.shape[1],      │
│  image.shape[0]), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)                           │
│                              return out                                      │
│                      except Exception:                                       │
│                          pass                                                │
│              except Exception:                                               │
│                  pass                                                        │
│                                                                              │
│          # Variant B: a predictor object with set_image/predict              │
│          if hasattr(model, &#x27;predictor&#x27;):                           │
│              try:                                                            │
│                  pred = model.predictor  # type: ignore                      │
│                  if hasattr(pred, &#x27;set_image&#x27;):                    │
│                      pred.set_image(image)                                   │
│                  if hasattr(pred, &#x27;predict&#x27;):                      │
│                      out = pred.predict(points=pts)  # type: ignore          │
│                      if isinstance(out, np.ndarray):                         │
│                          return out                                          │
│              except Exception:                                               │
│                  pass                                                        │
│                                                                              │
│      except Exception:                                                       │
│          return None                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│      # If none of the API variants worked, fall back to the quick            │
│  rasterization                                                               │
│      if initial_geom and len(initial_geom) &gt;= 3:                          │
│          return polygon_to_mask((h, w), initial_geom)                        │
│                                                                              │
│      return None                                                             │
│                                                                              │
│  def main():                                                                 │
│      parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()                                      │
│      parser.add_argument(&#x27;--weights_path&#x27;, type=str,               │
│  required=False, default=None,                                               │
│                          help=&#x27;path to MobileSAM weights (if            │
│  used)&#x27;)                                                                │
│      parser.add_argument(&#x27;--output_path&#x27;, type=str,                │
│  required=True,                                                              │
│                          help=&#x27;directory to write output csv&#x27;)     │
│      parser.add_argument(&#x27;--rgb_path&#x27;, type=str, required=True,    │
│                          help=&#x27;path to rgb image&#x27;)                 │
│      parser.add_argument(&#x27;--csv_path&#x27;, type=str, required=True,    │
│                          help=&#x27;path to input metadata CSV&#x27;)        │
│      parser.add_argument(&#x27;--test&#x27;, action=&#x27;store_true&#x27;,  │
│                          help=&#x27;run lightweight internal test&#x27;)     │
│      args = parser.parse_args()                                              │
│                                                                              │
│      if args.test:                                                           │
│          print(&#x27;[test] Running lightweight internal test (synthetic     │
│  data)&#x27;)                                                                │
│          img = np.zeros((60, 60, 3), dtype=np.uint8)                         │
│          tri = [(10,10), (50,15), (30,45)]                                   │
│          mask = polygon_to_mask((60, 60), tri)                               │
│          print(&#x27;[test] synthetic mask nonzero (expected &gt;0):&#x27;,  │
│  int(mask.sum() / 255))                                                      │
│          return                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│      if not os.path.exists(args.rgb_path):                                   │
│          print(&#x27;[error] rgb image not found:&#x27;, args.rgb_path)      │
│          sys.exit(2)                                                         │
│      image = cv2.imread(args.rgb_path)                                       │
│      if image is None:                                                       │
│          print(&#x27;[error] failed to read rgb image&#x27;)                 │
│          sys.exit(2)                                                         │
│      h, w = image.shape[:2]                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│      if not os.path.exists(args.csv_path):                                   │
│          print(&#x27;[error] csv not found:&#x27;, args.csv_path)            │
│          sys.exit(2)                                                         │
│      df = pd.read_csv(args.csv_path)                                         │
│                                                                              │
│      os.makedirs(args.output_path, exist_ok=True)                            │
│      out_csv = os.path.join(                                                 │
│          args.output_path,                                                   │
│          os.path.basename(args.csv_path).replace(&#x27;.csv&#x27;,           │
│  &#x27;_converted.csv&#x27;)                                                 │
│      )                                                                       │
│      out_df = df.copy()                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│      accum = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=np.uint8)                                │
│                                                                              │
│      def build_geom(row) -&gt; List[Tuple[int,int]]:                         │
│          # Try coords_x/y first                                              │
│          geom = []                                                           │
│          if isinstance(row.get(&#x27;coords_x&#x27;), str) and               │
│  isinstance(row.get(&#x27;coords_y&#x27;), str):                             │
│              geom = parse_coords_from_string(row[&#x27;coords_x&#x27;])      │
│          if not geom:                                                        │
│              xmin = int(row.get(&#x27;xmin&#x27;, 0)); ymin =                │
│  int(row.get(&#x27;ymin&#x27;, 0))                                           │
│              xmax = int(row.get(&#x27;xmax&#x27;, 0)); ymax =                │
│  int(row.get(&#x27;ymax&#x27;, 0))                                           │
│              if xmin is not None and ymin is not None and xmax is not None   │
│  and ymax is not None:                                                       │
│                  geom = [(xmin, ymin), (xmax, ymin), (xmax, ymax), (xmin,    │
│  ymax)]                                                                      │
│          return geom                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│      total = len(df)                                                         │
│      for i, row in df.iterrows():                                            │
│          geom = build_geom(row)                                              │
│          xmin = int(row.get(&#x27;xmin&#x27;, 0)); ymin =                    │
│  int(row.get(&#x27;ymin&#x27;, 0))                                           │
│          xmax = int(row.get(&#x27;xmax&#x27;, 0)); ymax =                    │
│  int(row.get(&#x27;ymax&#x27;, 0))                                           │
│          bbox = (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax)                                     │
│                                                                              │
│          refined = refine_mask_with_mobile_sam(image, geom, bbox,            │
│  args.weights_path)                                                          │
│          if refined is None:                                                 │
│              print(f&quot;[warn] skip index {i}: no refined mask             │
│  produced&quot;)                                                             │
│              continue                                                        │
│                                                                              │
│          non_overlap = cv2.bitwise_and(refined, cv2.bitwise_not(accum))      │
│          if cv2.countNonZero(non_overlap) == 0:                              │
│              print(f&quot;[warn] index {i}: no non-overlapping area;         │
│  skipping&quot;)                                                             │
│              continue                                                        │
│                                                                              │
│          accum = cv2.bitwise_or(accum, non_overlap)                          │
│                                                                              │
│          contour = contour_of_mask(non_overlap)                              │
│          if not contour:                                                     │
│              print(f&quot;[warn] index {i}: no contour found;                │
│  skipping&quot;)                                                             │
│              continue                                                        │
│                                                                              │
│          xs, ys = [], []                                                     │
│          for x, y in contour:                                                │
│              xs.append(x)                                                    │
│              ys.append(y)                                                    │
│          coords_x = &#x27;,&#x27;.join(map(str, xs))                         │
│          coords_y = &#x27;,&#x27;.join(map(str, ys))                         │
│          xi, yi, xa, ya = contour_to_bbox(contour)                           │
│                                                                              │
│          out_df.at[i, &#x27;xmin&#x27;] = xi                                 │
│          out_df.at[i, &#x27;ymin&#x27;] = yi                                 │
│          out_df.at[i, &#x27;xmax&#x27;] = xa                                 │
│          out_df.at[i, &#x27;ymax&#x27;] = ya                                 │
│          out_df.at[i, &#x27;coords_x&#x27;] = coords_x                       │
│          out_df.at[i, &#x27;coords_y&#x27;] = coords_y                       │
│          out_df.at[i, &#x27;type&#x27;] = &#x27;polyline&#x27;               │
│                                                                              │
│      out_df.to_csv(out_csv, index=False)                                     │
│      print(&#x27;[done] Wrote converted csv to&#x27;, out_csv)               │
│                                                                              │
│  if __name__ == &#x27;__main__&#x27;:                                        │
│      main()                                                                  │

│  def _poly_from_coords(coords_x, coords_y):                                  │
│      &quot;&quot;&quot;Convert comma-separated strings to a numpy int32 Nx2  │
│  polygon array.&quot;&quot;&quot;                                            │
│      if not isinstance(coords_x, str) or not isinstance(coords_y, str):      │
│          return None                                                         │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          xs = [float(v) for v in coords_x.split(&#x27;,&#x27;) if v.strip()  │
│  != &#x27;&#x27;]                                                            │
│          ys = [float(v) for v in coords_y.split(&#x27;,&#x27;) if v.strip()  │
│  != &#x27;&#x27;]                                                            │
│          if len(xs) != len(ys) or len(xs) &lt; 3:                            │
│              return None                                                     │
│          pts = np.array(list(zip(xs, ys)), dtype=np.int32)                   │
│          return pts                                                          │
│      except Exception:                                                       │
│          return None                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│  def _bbox_of_mask(mask):                                                    │
│      ys, xs = np.where(mask &gt; 0)                                          │
│      if len(xs) == 0:                                                        │
│          return None                                                         │
│      xmin, xmax = int(xs.min()), int(xs.max())                               │
│      ymin, ymax = int(ys.min()), int(ys.max())                               │
│      return [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax]                                         │
│                                                                              │
│  def _mask_from_initial_geom(image_shape, initial_geom, bbox=None):          │
│      &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                      │
│      Fallback mask rasterization from an initial geometry (poly) when        │
│  MobileSAM is unavailable.                                                   │

│      initial_geom: Nx2 array of points                                       │
│      bbox: optional [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax]                                 │

│      &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                      │
│      H, W = image_shape[:2]                                                  │
│      mask = np.zeros((H, W), dtype=np.uint8)                                 │
│      if initial_geom is None or len(initial_geom) &lt; 3:                    │
│          return mask                                                         │

│ Notes about this skeleton                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│  • Adaptive behavior: The refine_mask_with_mobile_sam function first tries   │
│    to call MobileSAM via a typical predict method. If that fails (MobileSAM  │
│    not installed, API mismatch, or runtime error), it falls back to a simple │
│    rasterization of the initial polygon geometry into a binary mask. This    │
│    keeps the end-to-end workflow functional in environments where MobileSAM  │
│    is unavailable, which is important for deterministic testing and          │
│    debugging.                                                                │
│  • CPU mode: The _init_mobile_sam helper explicitly uses device='cpu'. If    │
│    your MobileSAM API uses a different parameter (e.g., device or            │
│    device_id), adjust accordingly after your API reconnaissance.             │
│  • End-to-end flow: The script reads the input CSV, reconstructs initial     │
│    geometries, refines masks, enforces non-overlap via an accumulator mask,  │
│    extracts the largest contour for the final polyline, and writes the       │
│    updated CSV with updated bounding box and polyline coordinates.           │
│  • Testing: The --test flag runs a tiny synthetic test to sanity-check the   │
│    wrapper in your environment.                                              │

│      _mobile_sam_model = MobileSAM(weights_path=weights_path,                │
│  device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;)                                                     │
│      return _mobile_sam_model                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  def _mask_from_initial_geom(image_shape, initial_geom, bbox=None):          │
│      H, W = image_shape[:2]                                                  │
│      mask = np.zeros((H, W), dtype=np.uint8)                                 │
│      if initial_geom is None or len(initial_geom) &lt; 3:                    │
│          return mask                                                         │
│      pts = initial_geom.reshape(-1, 1, 2).astype(np.int32)                   │
│      cv2.fillPoly(mask, [pts], color=255)                                    │
│      return mask                                                             │
│                                                                              │
│  def refine_mask_with_mobile_sam(image, initial_geom, bbox,                  │
│  weights_path=None, model=None):                                             │
│      &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                      │
│      Adaptive wrapper around MobileSAM to refine a mask to a polyline.       │
│                                                                              │
│      image: HxWx3 uint8                                                      │
│      initial_geom: Nx2 array of initial polygon                              │
│      bbox: [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax]                                          │
│      weights_path: path to MobileSAM weights (if required)                   │
│      model: optional pre-instantiated MobileSAM object                       │
│      Returns: a binary mask (HxW uint8) or None                              │
│      &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                      │
│      m = model                                                               │
│      if m is None:                                                           │
│          try:                                                                │
│              m = _init_mobile_sam(weights_path)                              │
│          except Exception as e:                                              │
│              # Fallback: rasterize initial geometry                          │
│              return _mask_from_initial_geom(image.shape, initial_geom,       │
│  bbox)                                                                       │
│                                                                              │
│      if hasattr(m, &#x27;predict&#x27;):                                     │
│          pred = getattr(m, &#x27;predict&#x27;)                              │
│          import inspect                                                      │
│          try:                                                                │
│              sig = inspect.signature(pred)                                   │
│          except Exception:                                                   │
│              sig = None                                                      │
│          kwargs = {&#x27;image&#x27;: image}                                 │
│          if sig is not None:                                                 │
│              names = set(sig.parameters.keys())                              │
│              if &#x27;box&#x27; in names:                                    │
│                  kwargs[&#x27;box&#x27;] = bbox                              │
│              if &#x27;bbox&#x27; in names:                                   │
│                  kwargs[&#x27;bbox&#x27;] = bbox                             │
│              if &#x27;points&#x27; in names:                                 │
│                  cx = int((bbox[0] + bbox[2]) / 2)                           │
│                  cy = int((bbox[1] + bbox[3]) / 2)                           │
│                  kwargs[&#x27;points&#x27;] = np.array([[[cx, cy]]],         │
│  dtype=np.float32)                                                           │
│              if &#x27;point_coords&#x27; in names:                           │
│                  cx = int((bbox[0] + bbox[2]) / 2)                           │
│                  cy = int((bbox[1] + bbox[3]) / 2)                           │
│                  kwargs[&#x27;point_coords&#x27;] = np.array([[cx, cy]],     │
│  dtype=np.float32)                                                           │
│              if &#x27;point_labels&#x27; in names:                           │
│                  kwargs[&#x27;point_labels&#x27;] = np.array([1],            │
│  dtype=np.int64)                                                             │
│          try:                                                                │
│              res = pred(**kwargs)                                            │
│          except Exception as e:                                              │
│              res = None                                                      │
│          if isinstance(res, np.ndarray):                                     │
│              mask = res                                                      │
│          else:                                                               │
│              mask = None                                                     │
│          if mask is not None:                                                │
│              if mask.dtype != np.uint8:                                      │
│                  mask = mask.astype(np.uint8)                                │
│              if mask.shape[:2] != image.shape[:2]:                           │
│                  mask = cv2.resize(mask, (image.shape[1], image.shape[0]),   │
│  interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)                                            │
│              if mask.max() &gt; 1:                                           │
│                  mask = (mask &gt; 0).astype(np.uint8) * 255                 │
│              return mask                                                     │
│      return None                                                             │
│                                                                              │
│  def _poly_from_coords(coords_x, coords_y):                                  │
│      # Convert comma-separated coords to poly                                │
│      if not isinstance(coords_x, str) or not isinstance(coords_y, str):      │
│          return None                                                         │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          xs = [float(v) for v in coords_x.split(&#x27;,&#x27;) if v.strip()  │
│  != &#x27;&#x27;]                                                            │
│          ys = [float(v) for v in coords_y.split(&#x27;,&#x27;) if v.strip()  │
│  != &#x27;&#x27;]                                                            │
│          if len(xs) != len(ys) or len(xs) &lt; 3:                            │
│              return None                                                     │
│          pts = np.array(list(zip(xs, ys)), dtype=np.int32)                   │
│          return pts                                                          │
│      except Exception:                                                       │
│          return None                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│  def main():                                                                 │
│      parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()                                      │

│                                                                              │
│      if args.test:                                                           │
│          img = np.zeros((60, 60, 3), dtype=np.uint8)                         │
│          poly = np.array([[10,10], [50,12], [30,45]], dtype=np.int32)        │

│      rgb = cv2.cvtColor(cv2.imread(args.rgb_path), cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)        │

│                                                                              │

│          ymax = int(row.get(&#x27;ymax&#x27;, 0))                            │
│          coords_x = row.get(&#x27;coords_x&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;)              │
│          coords_y = row.get(&#x27;coords_y&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;)              │

│          bbox = [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax]                                     │

│          if mask is None:                                                    │

│                                                                              │

│                                                                              │

│          df_out.at[idx, &#x27;coords_x&#x27;] = xs                           │

│  #!/usr/bin/env python3                                                      │
│  import json                                                                 │
│  import os                                                                   │
│  import sys                                                                  │
│  import traceback                                                            │

│  def safe_write_json(path, data):                                            │
│      with open(path, &#x27;w&#x27;) as f:                                    │
│          json.dump(data, f, indent=2)                                        │
│                                                                              │
│  def main():                                                                 │
│      import argparse                                                         │
│      parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=&quot;Probe MobileSAM API  │
│  variants for end-to-end integration.&quot;)                                 │
│      parser.add_argument(&quot;--weights_path&quot;, type=str,               │
│  default=None, help=&quot;Optional path to MobileSAM weights.&quot;)         │
│      args = parser.parse_args()                                              │
│                                                                              │
│      report = {                                                              │
│          &quot;reachable&quot;: False,                                       │
│          &quot;constructor_variant&quot;: None,                              │
│          &quot;predict_signature&quot;: None,                                │
│          &quot;return_mask_shape&quot;: None,                                │
│          &quot;notes&quot;: &quot;&quot;,                                    │
│          &quot;variants_tried&quot;: []                                      │
│      }                                                                       │
│                                                                              │
│      # Stage 1: attempt to import MobileSAM                                  │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          from mobile_sam import MobileSAM                                    │
│          report[&quot;variants_tried&quot;].append(&quot;import_mobile_sam_  │
│  success&quot;)                                                              │
│      except Exception as e:                                                  │
│          report[&quot;notes&quot;] = &quot;Failed to import mobile_sam:      │
│  {}&quot;.format(e)                                                          │
│          safe_write_json(&quot;/app/mobile_sam_api_report.json&quot;,        │
│  report)                                                                     │
│          print(&quot;MobileSAM import failed. See                            │
│  /app/mobile_sam_api_report.json for details.&quot;)                         │
│          return                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│      # Stage 2: Try common constructor signatures                            │
│      model = None                                                            │
│      constructor_variants = []                                               │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          if args.weights_path:                                               │
│              constructor_variants.append((&quot;MobileSAM(weights_path={},   │
│  device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;)&quot;.format(args.weights_path),                    │
│                                           lambda:                            │
│  MobileSAM(args.weights_path, device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;)))                      │
│          constructor_variants.append((&quot;MobileSAM(weights_path={},       │
│  device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;) (alternate                                          │
│  syntax)&quot;.format(args.weights_path),                                    │
│                                       lambda:                                │
│  MobileSAM(weights_path=args.weights_path, device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;)))         │
│          constructor_variants.append((&quot;MobileSAM(weights_path={},       │
│  device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;) with keywords (if                                   │
│  supported)&quot;.format(args.weights_path),                                 │
│                                       lambda:                                │
│  MobileSAM(weights_path=args.weights_path, device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;)))         │
│      except Exception as e:                                                  │
│          # If signature isn&#x27;t this, we&#x27;ll fall through             │
│          report[&quot;notes&quot;] += &quot;\nConstructor variant attempt    │
│  partially failed: {}&quot;.format(e)                                        │
│                                                                              │
│      # Fallback to a very generic attempt if above fail                      │
│      if model is None:                                                       │
│          try:                                                                │
│              if args.weights_path:                                           │
│                  model = MobileSAM(args.weights_path,                        │
│  device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;)                                                     │
│                  report[&quot;variants_tried&quot;].append(&quot;MobileSAM(  │
│  weights_path, device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;)&quot;)                                │
│                  report[&quot;constructor_variant&quot;] =                   │
│  &quot;MobileSAM(weights_path, device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;)&quot;                 │
│              else:                                                           │
│                  model = MobileSAM(device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;)                   │
│                  report[&quot;variants_tried&quot;].append(&quot;MobileSAM(  │
│  device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;)&quot;)                                              │
│                  report[&quot;constructor_variant&quot;] =                   │
│  &quot;MobileSAM(device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;)&quot;                               │
│          except Exception as e:                                              │
│              report[&quot;notes&quot;] += &quot;\nGeneric constructor        │
│  failed: {}&quot;.format(e)                                                  │
│              model = None                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│      # If we still don&#x27;t have a model, bail with a report (reachable =  │
│  False)                                                                      │
│      if model is None:                                                       │
│          safe_write_json(&quot;/app/mobile_sam_api_report.json&quot;,        │
│  report)                                                                     │
│          print(&quot;Unable to instantiate MobileSAM. See                    │
│  /app/mobile_sam_api_report.json for details.&quot;)                         │
│          return                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│      # Stage 3: Attempt to discover a predict interface                      │
│      predict_candidates = []                                                 │
│      def try_call(predict_call):                                             │
│          # Prepare a tiny synthetic image and small polygon                  │
│          img = np.zeros((32, 32, 3), dtype=np.uint8)                         │
│          # simple triangle coordinates (as a mask prompt)                    │
│          pts = np.array([[8, 8], [24, 8], [16, 24]], dtype=np.int32)         │
│          try:                                                                │
│              mask = predict_call(img, pts)                                   │
│              if mask is not None:                                            │
│                  return mask                                                 │
│          except Exception:                                                   │
│              pass                                                            │
│          return None                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│      # Variant A: model.predict(image, points=pts)                           │
│      def vA(image, pts):                                                     │
│          return model.predict(image, points=pts)                             │
│                                                                              │
│      # Variant A alt: model.predict(image, point_coords=pts)                 │
│      def vA2(image, pts):                                                    │
│          return model.predict(image, point_coords=pts)                       │
│                                                                              │
│      # Variant B: SamPredictor-like, set_image + predict                     │
│      def vB(image, pts):                                                     │
│          if hasattr(model, &quot;predict&quot;):                             │
│              if hasattr(model, &quot;set_image&quot;):                       │
│                  model.set_image(image)                                      │
│                  return model.predict(pts)                                   │
│          return None                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│      predict_functions = [                                                   │
│          (&quot;predict(image, points=pts)&quot;, vA),                       │
│          (&quot;predict(image, point_coords=pts)&quot;, vA2),                │
│          (&quot;set_image+predict&quot; , vB),                               │
│      ]                                                                       │
│                                                                              │
│      mask_shape = None                                                       │
│      chosen = None                                                           │
│      for name, func in predict_functions:                                    │
│          mask = try_call(func)                                               │
│          if mask is not None:                                                │
│              chosen = (name, mask)                                           │
│              report[&quot;predict_signature&quot;] = name                    │
│              mask_type = mask.dtype.name if hasattr(mask,                    │
│  &#x27;dtype&#x27;) else &#x27;unknown&#x27;                                 │
│              if isinstance(mask, np.ndarray):                                │
│                  mask_shape = mask.shape                                     │
│              report[&quot;return_mask_shape&quot;] = mask_shape              │
│              report[&quot;reachable&quot;] = True                            │
│              report[&quot;constructor_variant&quot;] =                       │
│  report.get(&quot;constructor_variant&quot;) or                              │
│  &quot;identified_during_probe&quot;                                         │
│              report[&quot;notes&quot;] += &quot;\nSuccess with variant:      │
│  {}&quot;.format(name)                                                       │
│              break                                                           │
│                                                                              │
│      if chosen is None:                                                      │
│          report[&quot;notes&quot;] += &quot;\nNo predict variant succeeded   │
│  with synthetic test.&quot;                                                  │
│          report[&quot;return_mask_shape&quot;] = None                        │
│          report[&quot;reachable&quot;] = False                               │
│                                                                              │
│      # Persist report                                                        │
│      safe_write_json(&quot;/app/mobile_sam_api_report.json&quot;, report)    │
│      print(&quot;MobileSAM API reconnaissance complete. Wrote                │
│  /app/mobile_sam_api_report.json.&quot;)                                     │
│      return                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  if __name__ == &quot;__main__&quot;:                                        │
│      main()                                                                  │

│ How to run the probe                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│  • In your runtime (where /app exists), run:                                 │
│     • python3 /app/probe_mobile_sam_api.py --weights_path                    │
│       /path/to/weights.pth                                                   │
│     • If you don’t have a weights_path handy or MobileSAM accepts a default  │
│       path, omit the argument.                                               │
│  • After it finishes, you should have:                                       │
│     • /app/mobile_sam_api_report.json                                        │
│     • A console message indicating the result.                               │

│                                                                              │
│  • The probe writes a JSON like:                                             │
│                                                                              │
│ { "reachable": true, "constructor_variant": "MobileSAM(weights_path=...,     │

│ predict(image, points=pts)", "variants_tried": [                             │
│ "import_mobile_sam_success", "MobileSAM(weights_path, device='cpu')" ] }     │
│                                                                              │
│  • If MobileSAM is not usable in your environment, reachable would be false, │
│    and notes would indicate the reason.                                      │
│                                                                              │
│  3 Next steps after you share the report                                     │
│                                                                              │
│  • I’ll lock the path in /app/convert_masks.py to the exact API variant      │
│    found in your environment.                                                │
│  • Implement refine_mask_with_mobile_sam(image, initial_geom, bbox,          │
│    weights_path, model=None) using the exact constructor and predict call    │
│    pattern from the report (a 2–3 line core logic).                          │
│  • Remove or minimize the generic fallback (unless you want to keep a tiny   │
│    fallback for robustness).                                                 │
│  • Add a lightweight --test harness that exercises exactly that API path     │
│    with synthetic data.                                                      │
│  • Integrate into the end-to-end flow (non-overlapping masks, polyline       │
│    output, updated CSV).                                                     │
│                                                                              │
│ Notes and caveats                                                            │
│                                                                              │
│  • The probe script is designed to be resilient: it will try several common  │
│    API shapes and report what works.                                         │
│  • If your mobile_sam version uses a registry-based factory or a different   │
│    class name, the probe should still surface the workable constructor path  │
│    through the variants_tried and constructor_variant fields.                │
│  • The probe assumes CPU operation and won’t attempt GPU usage.              │
│                                                                              │
│ Deliverables you’ll get next                                                 │

│    exact API call on synthetic data.                                         │

│  def safe_call(fn, *args, **kwargs):                                         │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          return (&quot;success&quot;, fn(*args, **kwargs))                   │
│      except Exception as e:                                                  │
│          return (&quot;error&quot;, str(e), traceback.format_exc())          │

│  def main():                                                                 │

│                                                                              │
│      predict_variants = [                                                    │

│              except Exception:                                               │

│              break                                                           │
│                                                                              │
│      if not success:                                                         │

│          report[&quot;reachable&quot;] = False                               │
│                                                                              │

│  # Example structure:                                                        │
│  # MOBILE_SAM_PATH = {                                                       │
│  #     &quot;constructor_variant&quot;: &quot;MobileSAM(weights_path=...,    │

│  MOBILE_SAM_REPORT_PATH = &quot;/app/mobile_sam_api_report.json&quot;        │

│  def load_discovered_api_path():                                             │
│      if not os.path.exists(MOBILE_SAM_REPORT_PATH):                          │
│          return None                                                         │
│      with open(MOBILE_SAM_REPORT_PATH, &quot;r&quot;) as f:                  │
│          try:                                                                │
│              return json.load(f)                                             │
│          except Exception:                                                   │
│              return None                                                     │
│                                                                              │
│  def _init_model(weights_path, report):                                      │
│      # Attempt to import and construct a model using the exact API variant   │
│  from report                                                                 │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          import importlib                                                    │
│          mobile_sam = importlib.import_module(&quot;mobile_sam&quot;)        │
│      except Exception as e:                                                  │
│          raise RuntimeError(&quot;mobile_sam import failed:                  │
│  {}&quot;.format(e))                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│      # Lock in a deterministic constructor path (example; adjust after you   │
│  have the report)                                                            │
│      variant = report.get(&quot;constructor_variant&quot;, &quot;&quot;)     │
│      model = None                                                            │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          if &quot;MobileSAM(&quot; in variant:                               │
│              # Try common constructor patterns                               │
│              try:                                                            │
│                  model = mobile_sam.MobileSAM(weights_path=weights_path,     │
│  device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;)                                                     │
│              except TypeError:                                               │
│                  model = mobile_sam.MobileSAM(weights_path=weights_path)     │
│          else:                                                               │
│              # Fallback: try a direct call pattern                           │
│              model = mobile_sam.MobileSAM(weights_path=weights_path,         │
│  device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;)                                                     │
│      except Exception as e:                                                  │
│          raise RuntimeError(&quot;Failed to instantiate MobileSAM via        │
│  reported variant: {}&quot;.format(e))                                       │
│      return model                                                            │

│  def refine_mask_with_mobile_sam(image, initial_geom, bbox, weights_path,    │
│  model=None, report=None):                                                   │
│      &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                      │
│      image: HxWx3 uint8                                                      │
│      initial_geom: numpy array of shape (N, 2) or list of [x,y] pairs        │
│  representing initial polygon/points                                         │
│      bbox: [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax]                                          │
│      weights_path: path to MobileSAM weights                                 │
│      model: optional pre-instantiated model (if you want to reuse)           │
│      report: compatibility report dict loaded from                           │
│  /app/mobile_sam_api_report.json                                             │
│      Returns:                                                                │
│          mask: HxW uint8 binary mask (0/255)                                 │
│          or None if cannot produce a mask                                    │
│      &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                      │
│      # If a model is not provided, attempt to construct using the detected   │
│  API variant                                                                 │
│      if model is None:                                                       │
│          try:                                                                │
│              report_dict = report or load_discovered_api_path() or {}        │
│              model = _init_model(weights_path, report_dict)                  │
│          except Exception as e:                                              │
│              # If we can&#x27;t initialize MobileSAM, gracefully fail back   │
│  to None                                                                     │
│              print(&quot;MobileSAM initialization failed:                    │
│  {}&quot;.format(e))                                                         │
│              return None                                                     │
│                                                                              │
│      # Normalize initial geom to a suitable prompt                           │
│      pts = np.asarray(initial_geom, dtype=np.float32)                        │
│                                                                              │
│      # Try the exact API path first (as reported)                            │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          # Use the exact predict path hints from the report if available     │
│          # We don&#x27;t know exact signature here in this template; try a   │
│  robust multi-call strategy.                                                 │
│          mask = None                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│          # Variant A: model.predict(image, points=pts, labels=[1]*len(pts))  │
│          if hasattr(model, &quot;predict&quot;):                             │
│              labels = [1] * len(pts)                                         │
│              try:                                                            │
│                  mask = model.predict(image, points=pts, labels=labels)      │
│              except TypeError:                                               │
│                  # Alternate keyword names                                   │
│                  mask = model.predict(image, point_coords=pts,               │
│  point_labels=labels)                                                        │
│          # Variant B: SamPredictor-like: set_image then predict              │
│          if mask is None:                                                    │
│              if hasattr(model, &quot;set_image&quot;) and hasattr(model,     │
│  &quot;predict&quot;):                                                       │
│                  model.set_image(image)                                      │
│                  try:                                                        │
│                      mask = model.predict(points=pts, labels=labels)         │
│                  except Exception:                                           │
│                      pass                                                    │
│          if mask is None:                                                    │
│              # As a last resort, try an explicit bbox-based prompt if the    │
│  API supports it                                                             │
│              if hasattr(model, &quot;predict&quot;):                         │
│                  try:                                                        │
│                      mask = model.predict(image, box=bbox)                   │
│                  except Exception:                                           │
│                      pass                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│          if mask is None:                                                    │
│              # If the API path failed, return None                           │
│              return None                                                     │
│                                                                              │
│          # Ensure mask is numpy array of same spatial size                   │
│          if isinstance(mask, np.ndarray):                                    │
│              if mask.dtype != np.uint8:                                      │
│                  mask = (mask &gt; 0).astype(np.uint8) * 255                 │
│              if mask.shape[:2] != image.shape[:2]:                           │
│                  mask = cv2.resize(mask, (image.shape[1], image.shape[0]),   │
│  interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)                                            │
│              return mask                                                     │
│          else:                                                               │
│              return None                                                     │
│                                                                              │
│      except Exception as e:                                                  │
│          print(&quot;refine_mask_with_mobile_sam failed:                     │
│  {}&quot;.format(e))                                                         │
│          return None                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│  def decode_poly_coords(coords_x, coords_y):                                 │
│      # Helper to parse comma-separated coords into a numpy array of points   │
│      def parse_list(s):                                                      │
│          if isinstance(s, (list, tuple)):                                    │
│              return list(s)                                                  │
│          if isinstance(s, str):                                              │
│              # Expect comma-separated numbers                                │
│              parts = [p.strip() for p in s.strip().split(&quot;,&quot;) if   │
│  p.strip() != &quot;&quot;]                                                  │
│              nums = [float(p) for p in parts]                                │
│              return nums                                                     │
│          return []                                                           │
│      xs = parse_list(coords_x)                                               │
│      ys = parse_list(coords_y)                                               │
│      pts = [(xs[i], ys[i]) for i in range(min(len(xs), len(ys)))]            │
│      return pts                                                              │
│                                                                              │

│                                                                              │
│      # Load compatibility report if available                                │
│      report = load_discovered_api_path()                                     │
│                                                                              │
│      # For internal test                                                     │
│      if args.test:                                                           │

│                                                                              │

│                                                                              │

│              continue                                                        │

│          df_out.at[idx, &#x27;xmax&#x27;] = xmax&#x27;                       │
│          df_out.at[idx, &#x27;ymax&#x27;] = ymax&#x27;                       │

│  def safe_call(fn, *args, **kwargs):                                         │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          return (&quot;success&quot;, fn(*args, **kwargs))                   │
│      except Exception as e:                                                  │
│          return (&quot;error&quot;, str(e), traceback.format_exc())          │
│                                                                              │
│  def main():                                                                 │
│      parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()                                      │
│      parser.add_argument(&quot;--weights_path&quot;, type=str,               │
│  default=None, help=&quot;Path to MobileSAM weights (optional)&quot;)        │
│      args = parser.parse_args()                                              │
│                                                                              │
│      report = {                                                              │
│          &quot;constructor_variant&quot;: None,                              │
│          &quot;predict_signature&quot;: None,                                │
│          &quot;return_mask_shape&quot;: None,                                │
│          &quot;reachable&quot;: False,                                       │
│          &quot;notes&quot;: &quot;&quot;                                     │
│      }                                                                       │
│                                                                              │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          import importlib                                                    │
│          mobile_sam = importlib.import_module(&quot;mobile_sam&quot;)        │
│      except Exception as e:                                                  │
│          report[&quot;notes&quot;] = f&quot;Failed to import mobile_sam:     │
│  {e}&quot;                                                                   │
│          _write(report)                                                      │
│          return                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│      # Try common constructor variants                                       │
│      ctor_variants = [                                                       │
│          (&quot;MobileSAM(weights_path, device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;)&quot;,       │
│  lambda: mobile_sam.MobileSAM(args.weights_path, device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;) ),  │
│          (&quot;MobileSAM(weights_path, device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;) alt2&quot;,  │
│  lambda: mobile_sam.MobileSAM(args.weights_path, device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;) ),  │
│          (&quot;MobileSAM(weights_path, device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;)              │
│  direct&quot;, lambda: mobile_sam.MobileSAM(args.weights_path,               │
│  &quot;cpu&quot;) ),                                                         │

│      chosen = None                                                           │
│      for label, ctor in ctor_variants:                                       │

│              break                                                           │

│  succeeded in this runtime.&quot;                                            │

│                                                                              │
│      # Try plausible predict interfaces                                      │
│      import numpy as np                                                      │
│      test_img = np.zeros((8, 8, 3), dtype=np.uint8)                          │
│      test_points = np.array([[2,2], [5,2], [3,6]], dtype=np.float32)         │
│      test_labels = np.array([1,1,1], dtype=np.int64)                         │
│                                                                              │
│      predict_variants = [                                                    │
│          (&quot;predict(image, points=pts, labels=labels)&quot;, lambda:     │
│  model.predict(test_img, points=test_points, labels=test_labels)),           │
│          (&quot;predict(image, point_coords=pts,                             │
│  point_labels=labels)&quot;, lambda: model.predict(test_img,                 │
│  point_coords=test_points, point_labels=test_labels)),                       │
│          # Optional: support a SamPredictor-like path later                  │
│      ]                                                                       │
│                                                                              │
│      success = False                                                         │
│      for label, call in predict_variants:                                    │
│          try:                                                                │
│              res = call()                                                    │
│              report[&quot;predict_signature&quot;] = label                   │
│              if isinstance(res, (list, tuple)) and len(res) == 0:            │
│                  continue                                                    │

│              else:                                                           │

│              success = True                                                  │
│              break                                                           │
│          except Exception:                                                   │
│              continue                                                        │
│                                                                              │

│  succeeded in this runtime.&quot;                                            │
│          report[&quot;reachable&quot;] = False                               │
│                                                                              │

│  def load_report():                                                          │
│      if not os.path.exists(MOBILE_SAM_REPORT_PATH):                          │
│          return None                                                         │
│      with open(MOBILE_SAM_REPORT_PATH, &quot;r&quot;) as f:                  │
