│ -----\n#!/usr/bin/env python3\nimport json\nimport os\nimport sys\nimport    │
│ time\nimport traceback\nimport numpy as np\nimport cv2\nimport               │
│ inspect\n\ndef robust_import_mobile_sam():\n    try:\n        import         │
│ importlib\n        mob = importlib.import_module("mobile_sam")\n             │
│ return mob\n    except Exception as e:\n        return None\n\ndef           │
│ build_synthetic_input(H=8, W=8):\n    img = np.zeros((H, W, 3),              │
│ dtype=np.uint8)\n    # small white square\n    cv2.rectangle(img, (1,1),     │
│ (6,6), (255,255,255), -1)\n    # tiny bbox for initial_geom\n    init_geom = │
│ [(2,2), (5,2), (5,5), (2,5)]\n    return img, init_geom\n\ndef               │
│ try_predict_with_signature(model, image, init_geom, bbox):\n    """\n    Try │
│ a few plausible predict() signatures on the given model.\n    Returns (mask, │
│ used_signature_str) or (None, None) if all fail.\n    """\n    sigs_tried =  │
│ []\n    last_exc = None\n    # Normalize initial geom to numpy array for     │
│ convenience\n    pts = np.array(init_geom, dtype=np.float32)\n\n    # Try a  │
│ few common keyword names\n    candidate_calls = [\n        {"points":        │
│ pts},\n        {"point_coords": pts},\n        {"boxes": [bbox]},\n          │
│ {"box": bbox},\n        {"points": [pts], "point_labels": [1]*len(pts)},\n   │
│ {"poly": pts},\n    ]\n\n    for kw in candidate_calls:\n                    │

│ def try_predict_with_signature(model, image, init_geom, bbox): """ Try a few │
│ plausible predict() signatures on the given model. Returns (mask,            │
│ used_signature_str) or (None, None) if all fail. """ sigs_tried = []         │
│ last_exc = None # Normalize initial geom to numpy array for convenience pts  │
│ = np.array(init_geom, dtype=np.float32)                                      │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  # Try a few common keyword names                                            │
│  candidate_calls = [                                                         │
│      {&quot;points&quot;: pts},                                              │
│      {&quot;point_coords&quot;: pts},                                        │
│      {&quot;boxes&quot;: [bbox]},                                            │
│      {&quot;box&quot;: bbox},                                                │
│      {&quot;points&quot;: [pts], &quot;point_labels&quot;: [1]*len(pts)},    │
│      {&quot;poly&quot;: pts},                                                │
│  ]                                                                           │
│                                                                              │
│  for kw in candidate_calls:                                                  │
│      sigs_tried.append(kw)                                                   │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          # Some APIs use positional; we try keyword-based first              │
│          mask = model.predict(image, **kw)                                   │
│          return mask, str(kw)                                                │
│      except Exception as e:                                                  │
│          last_exc = e                                                        │
│          continue                                                            │
│                                                                              │
│  # If there&#x27;s a predictor sub-object (SamPredictor style)               │
│  if hasattr(model, &quot;predictor&quot;):                                   │
│      pred = getattr(model.predictor, &quot;predict&quot;, None)              │
│      if callable(pred):                                                      │
│          for kw in candidate_calls:                                          │
│              try:                                                            │
│                  mask = pred(image, **kw)                                    │
│                  return mask, &quot;predictor.&quot; + str(kw)               │
│              except Exception:                                               │
│                  continue                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│  # If we reach here, nothing worked                                          │
│  if last_exc:                                                                │
│      # print traceback briefly                                               │
│      pass                                                                    │
│  return None, None                                                           │

│ def load_mobile_sam_exact(cons_variant, weights_path=None): """ Attempt to   │
│ instantiate MobileSAM using the exact variant reported. This is a            │
│ best-effort helper. If the exact form cannot be instantiated (e.g., API      │
│ shift), we raise a clear error to trigger fallback or user intervention. """ │
│ global _mobile_sam_model if _mobile_sam_model is not None: return            │
│ _mobile_sam_model                                                            │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  try:                                                                        │
│      import mobile_sam as ms                                                 │
│      # Try to interpret a few common patterns based on the variant string    │
│      # If the variant literally resembles &quot;MobileSAM(weights_path=...,  │
│  device=&#x27;cpu&#x27;)&quot;,                                              │
│      # we still instantiate via the canonical constructor if possible.       │
│      # Here we attempt a straightforward path first.                         │
│      if weights_path is not None:                                            │
│          try:                                                                │
│              model = ms.MobileSAM(weights_path=weights_path,                 │
│  device=&quot;cpu&quot;)                                                     │
│          except TypeError:                                                   │
│              model = ms.MobileSAM(weights_path, device=&quot;cpu&quot;)      │
│      else:                                                                   │
│          # Try a minimal constructor                                         │
│          model = ms.MobileSAM(device=&quot;cpu&quot;)                        │
│      _mobile_sam_model = model                                               │
│      return model                                                            │
│  except Exception as e:                                                      │
│      raise RuntimeError(&quot;Failed to instantiate MobileSAM with exact     │

│ def refine_mask_with_mobile_sam_exact(image, initial_geom, bbox,             │
│ weights_path=None, model=None, report=None): """ Deterministic wrapper that  │
│ uses the exact MobileSAM API path identified in the runtime report. - image: │
│ HxWx3 numpy array (uint8) - initial_geom: list of (x,y) coordinates          │
│ describing the initial mask - bbox: (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) - weights_path: │
│ path to MobileSAM weights - model: optional pre-instantiated model - report: │
│ dict loaded from /app/mobile_sam_api_report.json (optional; for diagnostics) │
│ Returns: - mask: 0/255 uint8 numpy array with shape equal to image height    │
│ and width - or raises a clear exception if the path fails """ # Load the     │
│ exact model using helper if not provided if model is None: try: model =      │
│ load_mobile_sam_exact("detected", weights_path=weights_path) except          │
│ Exception as e: raise RuntimeError("Could not instantiate MobileSAM exact    │
│ path: {}".format(e))                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  # Prepare initial inputs for predict                                        │
│  import numpy as np                                                          │
│  pts = np.array(initial_geom, dtype=np.float32)                              │
│                                                                              │
│  # Attempt to call predict with several common exact keyword forms, guided   │
│  by the report if available.                                                 │
│  # The actual call will be replaced by the exact pattern once the report is  │
│  available.                                                                  │
│  if hasattr(model, &quot;predict&quot;):                                     │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          # Try a few plausible exact kwarg names                             │
│          try:                                                                │
│              mask = model.predict(image, points=pts)                         │
│              sig = &quot;predict(image, points=pts)&quot;                    │
│          except TypeError:                                                   │
│              mask = model.predict(image, point_coords=pts)                   │
│              sig = &quot;predict(image, point_coords=pts)&quot;              │
│          except TypeError:                                                   │
│              mask = model.predict(image, box=bbox)                           │
│              sig = &quot;predict(image, box=bbox)&quot;                      │
│          except Exception as e:                                              │
│              raise e                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│          # Normalize mask to (H,W) uint8                                     │
│          m = mask                                                            │
│          if isinstance(m, (list, tuple)):                                    │
│              m = np.array(m)                                                 │
│          if m.dtype != np.uint8:                                             │
│              if m.dtype == np.bool_:                                         │
│                  m = (m.astype(np.uint8) * 255)                              │
│              else:                                                           │
│                  m = m.astype(np.uint8)                                      │
│          if m.ndim == 3 and m.shape[2] == 1:                                 │
│              m = cv2.cvtColor(m, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)                         │
│                                                                              │
│          h, w = image.shape[:2]                                              │
│          if m.shape[:2] != (h, w):                                           │
│              m = cv2.resize(m, (w, h), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)      │
│                                                                              │
│          return m                                                            │
│      except Exception as e:                                                  │
│          raise RuntimeError(&quot;Deterministic path failed on predict       │
│  call: {}&quot;.format(e))                                                   │
│  else:                                                                       │
│      raise RuntimeError(&quot;MobileSAM model has no predict() method;       │
│  cannot use exact path.&quot;)                                               │
